body: The Meadow quality and performance sweep is shipped and device-checked. PRs #258 to #260 delivered the sharp scene, grouped glass, the night overlay shader, insect sway and the background-pause setting; #261 fixed the noon regression by drawing the water sparkles in one masked pass. On merged main d0cd3b7a the Note 10+ holds 62 fps at noon and midnight and the owner's MacBook Pro matches its pre-sweep 120 fps. The look is unchanged and was approved by the owner, as were 100% scale and the heat results. The sharpening hitch (spec 10.14) was deferred by the owner and moved to thread meadow-sharpening-hitch.
